title: Electron shells across period 3
caption: For the first 20 elements the shells fill 2, then 8, then 8. Sodium to argon all have full first and second shells; the third shell gains one electron per element, which is why they sit in groups 1, 2, 17 and 18.
alt: Four atoms: sodium 2, 8, 1; magnesium 2, 8, 2; chlorine 2, 8, 7; argon 2, 8, 8.
description: Argon: shells 2, 8, 8, a full outer shell.
